projects.title: WhatsApp AI Agent for Microsoft 365
projects.summary: A WhatsApp bot connected to SharePoint, Outlook, Outlook Calendar and Microsoft Teams through the Microsoft Graph API, with a GPT-4o mini assistant built in.
projects.reel: SharePoint, Outlook, Calendar and Teams from a WhatsApp chat, with a GPT-4o mini assistant and voice messages.
features: Ask questions about SharePoint files
Upload files to SharePoint straight from WhatsApp
Write and send emails, and schedule meetings
Speak instead of typing: voice messages are transcribed with Azure AI Speech
cvBullets: Built a WhatsApp AI agent that answers questions about SharePoint documents, uploads files, and works with Outlook mail and calendar through Microsoft Graph API, including voice notes transcribed with Azure AI Speech.

Added leave-request and approval workflows with role-based permissions (employee, manager, HR), audit logging, multi-language replies (English, Arabic, French), rate limiting, retries, and health/readiness checks.

projects.title: Full-Stack Portfolio Platform
projects.summary: This website: a React 19 frontend on Cloudflare Pages and an ASP.NET Core 10 API with PostgreSQL, with a private content studio and a CI/CD pipeline that tests every change before it goes live.
features: Content studio protected by a sign-in that never sends the password
ASP.NET Core 10 API with EF Core, PostgreSQL and FluentValidation, in Docker on Render
GitHub Actions pipeline: integration tests on a real PostgreSQL database, then deploys and production checks
AI CV assistant with a Google Gemini fallback
cvBullets: Built a portfolio site with a JWT-protected content studio: React 19 frontend on Cloudflare Pages and an ASP.NET Core 10 API with EF Core, PostgreSQL, and FluentValidation in Docker on Render.

Set up a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline that runs xUnit integration tests against a real PostgreSQL database, deploys only what changed, and runs production checks after each release; added an AI CV assistant with a Google Gemini fallback.

projects.title: Live Noise Cancellation Model
projects.summary: A model that works out what the background noise in an audio clip is, then removes it using reference recordings of that kind of noise. Integrated with Microsoft Teams.
projects.reel: A CNN trained on UrbanSound8K spots the background noise, then spectral gating removes it. Integrated with Teams.
features: CNN trained on the UrbanSound8K dataset to classify background noise
Spectral gating with noisereduce, using reference recordings of each noise type
Integrated with Microsoft Teams
cvBullets: Trained and evaluated a CNN on UrbanSound8K to classify 10 environmental noise types, then removed the top-3 detected noises with spectral gating using reference recordings; integrated the solution with Microsoft Teams.
Served the model through a FastAPI REST API (predict and denoise endpoints) with a React + Vite frontend.

projects.title: Apple and Banana Detection App
projects.summary: A Flask web app that runs a custom-trained YOLOv8s model on uploaded photos and draws labelled bounding boxes around each apple and banana.
projects.reel: A Flask web app running a custom-trained YOLOv8s model that boxes every apple and banana in a photo.
features: Custom-trained YOLOv8s model for two classes: apple and banana
Upload a photo in the browser and get labelled bounding boxes back
Served as a Flask web app
cvBullets: Trained a custom YOLOv8s object-detection model on 240 labeled images and built a Dockerized Flask app, deployable to Render, that draws labeled bounding boxes on uploaded photos.

projects.title: Taskify Task Management API
projects.summary: A task management REST API with JWT authentication and Admin, Manager and Employee roles, built with ASP.NET Core and Entity Framework Core on MySQL.
projects.reel: A backend API for creating, updating and tracking tasks, using Entity Framework Core with MySQL.
features: JWT authentication with Admin, Manager and Employee roles
Task assignment, comments and notifications
Recurring tasks
Export to PDF, Excel and CSV
cvBullets: Built a REST API with JWT authentication and Admin, Manager, and Employee roles, covering task assignment, comments, notifications, recurring tasks, and PDF/Excel/CSV export.

projects.title: WhatsApp Appointment Booking Bot for Doctors
projects.summary: A chatbot that lets patients book appointments with doctors through WhatsApp, with every booking stored in a SQL database.
projects.reel: Patients book appointments with doctors through WhatsApp, with bookings stored in a SQL database.
features: Patients book with a doctor in a WhatsApp chat
Bookings are stored in a SQL database
Built on the WhatsApp Cloud API
cvBullets: Built a WhatsApp chatbot for booking medical appointments, with bookings stored in a SQL database.

projects.title: SharePoint On-Premises Data Retrieval with LDAP
projects.summary: An ASP.NET Core service built at work that connects to an LDAP server to retrieve data for SharePoint on-premises.
projects.reel: An ASP.NET Core service that connects to an LDAP server to retrieve data for SharePoint on-premises.
features: Built with ASP.NET Core and C#
Connects to the organization's LDAP server to retrieve directory data
Makes that data available to SharePoint on-premises
Built for a real workplace, as part of my job
cvBullets: Developed an ASP.NET Core service to retrieve LDAP directory data for a SharePoint on-premises environment.

experience.title: AI Software Engineer / Technical Lead
bullets: Lead a three-developer team: plan and assign work, review code, gather client requirements, and coordinate delivery of enterprise AI solutions.
Design and build the C#/.NET REST API layer of an AI-enabled social media management platform, including registration, login, password reset, and JWT authentication.
Develop Azure OpenAI features that turn social media and competitor data into account insights, best-time-to-post recommendations, and competitor analysis.
Enforce per-account data isolation by scoping every SQL query to the authenticated account and adding AI guardrails, so accounts in the same organization never see each other’s data.
Build SQL Server-backed endpoints on existing stored procedures and adapt database tables for AI integration without breaking current application logic.
Configured and published two SharePoint-grounded Copilot Studio agents to Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Teams, and SharePoint, giving staff self-service answers from company documents.
Built a WhatsApp Cloud API bot for The Net Holding and resolved Meta Business Verification rejections and domain verification (Cloudflare DNS) needed to run it on a verified business account.

Built approximately 10 Power Automate flows and Power Apps forms that moved approvals and requests onto SharePoint.
Developed backend features for internal and client applications using C#, ASP.NET MVC, and SQL Server.
Delivered 12 Microsoft Copilot training sessions for managers and staff at AFC, AFC Live, and Aïshti.

headline: AI Software Engineer (C#/.NET)

Lead a three-developer team delivering Azure OpenAI insights, JWT-secured ASP.NET Core REST APIs, and SQL Server integrations for an AI-enabled social media platform, plus Copilot Studio agents and WhatsApp AI assistants connected to Microsoft 365 through Microsoft Graph.
